Title: Q: change of target and sergei voshkov

Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body:
Sergei blocks successfully, triggering his built in effect 'look at
hand and....'. Acting player wishes to play change of target first,
which will end the action.

Does the Sergei player get to use his effect before the action is
ended as it is triggered first? Or does the COT trigger first due to
acting player getting to 'use' 'when blocked' effects first?

T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The acting player may play CoT first, but that would be to the advantage of the
blocking player, who would then get to look at the acting player's hand after
the acting player drew the card to replace CoT (and it would be doubly
advantageous to the blocker if the drawn card is an action card).
